# Orb puffer, phase 1: blockout at the spec's sizes (generated by make_puffer.py).
new
material new Iron --base-color 0.275 0.275 0.471 --no-slot
material new Copper --base-color 1.000 0.663 0.212 --no-slot
material new Brass --base-color 1.000 0.761 0.278 --no-slot
material new Petal --base-color 0.902 0.459 0.584 --no-slot
material new Rubber --base-color 0.604 0.388 0.565 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Plinth --vertices 8 --radius 0.7469 --depth 0.3300 --location 0.0000 0 0.1650 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Iron
add mesh cylinder --name Drum --vertices 8 --radius 0.6007 --depth 0.7900 --location 0.0000 0 0.7250 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Copper
add mesh cone --name Lid --vertices 8 --radius1 0.6007 --radius2 0.1894 --depth 0.2100 --location 0 0 1.2250 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Brass
add mesh cylinder --name Barrel --vertices 8 --radius 0.1894 --depth 0.6400 --location 0.0000 0 1.6500 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Brass
add mesh cone --name Mouth --vertices 8 --radius1 0.1894 --radius2 0.4330 --depth 0.2500 --location 0 0 2.0950 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Petal
add mesh cone --name Tip0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.30 --radius2 0 --depth 0.280 --location 0 0 0.140
scale 0.5 1 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 16 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
translate 0.3300 0.0000 2.1400
apply --location
material assign Petal
add mesh cone --name Tip1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.30 --radius2 0 --depth 0.280 --location 0 0 0.140
scale 0.5 1 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 16 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 0 90
apply --rotation
translate 0.0000 0.3300 2.1400
apply --location
material assign Petal
add mesh cone --name Tip2 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.30 --radius2 0 --depth 0.280 --location 0 0 0.140
scale 0.5 1 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 16 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 0 180
apply --rotation
translate -0.3300 0.0000 2.1400
apply --location
material assign Petal
add mesh cone --name Tip3 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.30 --radius2 0 --depth 0.280 --location 0 0 0.140
scale 0.5 1 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 16 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 0 270
apply --rotation
translate -0.0000 -0.3300 2.1400
apply --location
material assign Petal
select Mouth Tip0 Tip1 Tip2 Tip3
active Mouth
join
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bulb --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.400 --location -1.080 0 0.790
material assign Rubber
add mesh cylinder --name Hose --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.24 --location -0.62 0 0.790 --rotation 0 90 0
material assign Rubber
add mesh cylinder --name Cup --vertices 8 --radius 0.3139 --depth 0.2600 --location 1.0700 0 0.8500 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Brass
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0.66 0 0.820
scale 0.26 0.11 0.11
apply --scale
material assign Brass
